Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَصَيِّرْنَا إِلَى مَحْبُوبِكَ مِنَ التَّوْبَةِ
Translation: And lead us to what You love of repentance

Arabic text: وَأَزِلْنَا عَنْ مَكْرُوهِكَ مِنَ الْإِصْرَارِ
Translation: And remove us from what You dislike of persistence [in sin]

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَ مَتَى وَقَفْنَا بَيْنَ نَقْصَيْنِ فِيْ دِينٍ
Translation: O Allah, whenever we are caught between two deficiencies in religion

Arabic text: أَوْ دُنْيَا فَأَوْقِعِ النَّقْصَ بِأَسْرَعِهِمَا فَنَاءً
Translation: Or worldly affairs, then let the deficiency occur in what perishes more quickly

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلِ التَّوْبَةَ فِيْ أَطْوَلِهِمَا بَقَاءً
Translation: And grant repentance in what endures longer

Arabic text: وَإِذَا هَمَمْنَا بِهَمَّيْنِ يُرْضِيكَ أَحَدُهُمَا عَنَّا
Translation: And when we are concerned with two matters, one of which pleases You regarding us

Arabic text: وَيُسْخِطُكَ الْآخَرُ عَلَيْنَا
Translation: And the other displeases You against us

Arabic text: فَمِلْ بِنَا إِلَى مَا يُرْضِيكَ عَنَّا
Translation: Then incline us toward what pleases You regarding us

Arabic text: وَأَوْهِنْ قُوَّتَنَا عَمَّا يُسْخِطُكَ عَلَيْنَا
Translation: And weaken our strength toward what displeases You against us

Arabic text: وَلَا تُخَلِّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ بَيْنَ نُفُوسِنَا وَاخْتِيَارِهَا
Translation: And do not leave our souls in that to their own choosing

Arabic text: فَإِنَّهَا مُخْتَارَةٌ لِلْبَاطِلِ إِلَّا مَا وَفَّقْتَ أَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ إِلَّا مَا رَحِمْتَ
Translation: For they choose falsehood except what You grant success, commanding evil except what You have mercy upon

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الضُّعْفِ خَلَقْتَنَا
Translation: O Allah, You have created us from weakness

Arabic text: وَعَلَى الْوَهْنِ بَنَيْتَنَا، وَمِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ ابْتَدَأْتَنَا
Translation: And built us upon frailty, and from a despised fluid You originated us

Arabic text: فَلَا حَوْلَ لَنَا إِلَّا بِقُوَّتِكَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ لَنَا إِلَّا بِعَوْنِكَ
Translation: So we have no power except through Your strength, and no strength except through Your help

Arabic text: فَأَيِّدْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ وَسَدِّدْنَا بِتَسْدِيْدِكَ
Translation: So support us with Your guidance and direct us with Your direction

Arabic text: وَأَعْمِ أَبْصَارَ قُلُوبِنَا عَمَّا خَالَفَ مَحَبَّتَكَ
Translation: And blind the eyes of our hearts from what opposes Your love

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْعَلْ لِشَيْءٍ مِنْ جَوَارِحِنَا نُفُوْذًا فِيْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
Translation: And do not allow any of our limbs to have influence in disobeying You

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ هَمَسَاتِ قُلُوبِنَا وَحَرَكَاتِ أَعْضَائِنَا
Translation: And make the whispers of our hearts and the movements of our limbs

Arabic text: وَلَمَحَاتِ أَعْيُنِنَا، وَلَهَجَاتِ أَلْسِنَتِنَا فِيْ مُوْجِبَاتِ ثَوَابِكَ
Translation: And the glances of our eyes, and the utterances of our tongues in what necessitates Your reward

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا تَفُوتَنَا حَسَنَةٌ نَسْتَحِقُّ بِهَا جَزَاءَكَ
Translation: So that no good deed passes us by through which we deserve Your recompense

Arabic text: وَلَا تَبْقَى لَنَا سَيِّئَةٌ نَسْتَوْجِبُ بِهَا عِقَابَكَ
Translation: And no sin remains with us through which we deserve Your punishment
